envelope.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted recursively; integers remain base-10 integers; no floats; no Unicode normalization or whitespace participates in the digest
envelope.compatibility: A producer change is compatible only when every valid 1.0.0 event retains the same identity, timestamp meaning and validation result. Otherwise issue a new major schema version.
envelope.partition_rule: partition_key must equal user_id so one user remains ordered in one Kinesis shard
envelope.payload_digest: SHA-256 of canonical full envelope excluding ingest_time_ms
envelope.privacy: user_id is pseudonymous; payload forbids names, email, phone, address, free text and credentials; logs contain identifiers only after one-way redaction

event_time.advance_rule: after a valid event is classified, max_valid_event_time_seen becomes max(previous maximum,event_time_ms)
event_time.beyond_watermark_effect: raw archive and LATE_BEYOND_WATERMARK ledger/outbox only; no live session or aggregate mutation
event_time.boundary: event_time_ms equal to the watermark is accepted_late

categories.on_time: event_time_ms >= previous max_valid_event_time_seen, or no previous maximum exists

event_time.idle_partition: no global minimum exists, so an idle shard cannot stall another shard. Its stored watermark remains unchanged; returning records are evaluated against it and cannot move it backward.
event_time.initial_state: watermark is undefined until the first valid event; that event is on_time
event_time.processing_order: Kinesis sequence-number order within the shard with Lambda parallelization factor 1
event_time.scope: per Kinesis shard; user_id partitioning keeps each user in one scope
event_time.watermark_before_record: max_valid_event_time_seen - allowed_lateness_ms; it never moves backward

identity.after_horizon: archive and quarantine as EXPIRED_IDENTITY; make no live application effect because EventPulse does not promise unbounded deduplication
identity.conflicting_duplicate: same event_id and different payload_digest within the horizon: preserve the variant in raw archive, write IDENTITY_CONFLICT quarantine ledger/outbox, make no engagement mutation
identity.identical_duplicate: same event_id and payload_digest within the horizon: preserve one raw object, increment duplicate metric, make no state or output mutation
identity.ttl_boundary: age <= horizon remains protected; age > horizon is expired

retention.replay_boundary: Only raw events retained and integrity-verified inside the seven-day archive window are promised replayable.

sessions.boundary: delta exactly equal to inactivity_gap_ms remains in the same session
sessions.bridge_event: an accepted_late event can join two open components; recompute them as one component before publication
sessions.closure: a session closes only when shard watermark > session_end_ms + inactivity_gap_ms
sessions.membership: events for one user are sorted by (event_time_ms,event_id); adjacent events with delta <= inactivity_gap_ms are connected
sessions.open_state: retain all accepted member identities and times needed to recompute components until closure
sessions.output_version: 1 inside a generation; a different replay generation never overwrites the live generation
sessions.published_correction: live sessions are published only after closure; beyond-watermark events never rewrite them. A separately authorized replay writes a different generation.
sessions.session_id: SHA-256 of contract_version, generation_id, user_id and the sorted member event IDs at closure
